mapper.sql: FROM learning_course c JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id AND e.active=1 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.student_id AND u.role_id=10 AND u.status='0' WHERE c.mentor_id=#{mentor} AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE role_id=20 AND status='0'
SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{id} AND role_id=20 AND status='0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT #{mentor} AS mentor_id,u.id AS student_id,'MOOD' AS kind,0 AS scope_key, 'Two consecutive weeks with a low mood check-in.' AS reason, IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mood_entry m WHERE m.student_id=u.id AND m.week_start=#{week}),#{week},#{previous}) AS event_date
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mood_notice_ack n WHERE n.student_id=u.id AND n.notice_version=#{notice}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mood_entry a JOIN mood_entry b ON b.student_id=a.student_id AND b.week_start=DATE_SUB(a.week_start,INTERVAL 7 DAY) WHERE a.student_id=u.id AND a.mood_level IN (1,2) AND b.mood_level IN (1,2) AND a.week_start=IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mood_entry m WHERE m.student_id=u.id AND m.week_start=#{week}),#{week},#{previous}))

SELECT #{mentor} AS mentor_id,u.id AS student_id,'ACTIVITY' AS kind,c.id AS scope_key,c.id AS course_id, 'No chapter opened for at least 14 days; learning is not complete.' AS reason, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(p.last_visited_at) FROM learning_chapter_progress p JOIN learning_chapter ch ON ch.id=p.chapter_id WHERE p.student_id=u.id AND ch.course_id=c.id),e.create_time),'%Y-%m-%d') AS event_date
AND e.create_time <= #{cutoff} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_chapter ch WHERE ch.course_id=c.id AND ch.deleted=0 AND ch.status='PUBLISHED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_chapter ch WHERE ch.course_id=c.id AND ch.deleted=0 AND ch.status='PUBLISHED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_chapter_progress p WHERE p.chapter_id=ch.id AND p.student_id=u.id AND p.completed_at IS NOT NULL)) AND COALESCE((SELECT MAX(p.last_visited_at) FROM learning_chapter_progress p JOIN learning_chapter ch ON ch.id=p.chapter_id WHERE p.student_id=u.id AND ch.course_id=c.id),e.create_time) <= #{cutoff}

SELECT #{mentor} AS mentor_id,u.id AS student_id,'ASSIGNMENT' AS kind,a.id AS scope_key,c.id AS course_id,a.id AS assignment_id, CONCAT('Assignment overdue by at least 3 days: ',LEFT(a.title,150)) AS reason,DATE_FORMAT(a.due_at,'%Y-%m-%d') AS event_date FROM assignment a JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=a.course_id JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id AND e.active=1 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.student_id AND u.role_id=10 AND u.status='0' WHERE c.mentor_id=#{mentor} AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND a.status='PUBLISHED' AND a.due_at IS NOT NULL AND a.due_at <= #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignment_submission sub WHERE sub.assignment_id=a.id AND sub.student_id=u.id AND sub.attempt_no>0)
SELECT * FROM follow_up_reminder WHERE mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND kind=#{kind} AND scope_key=#{scopeKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up_reminder SET active=1,reviewed=0,reviewed_at=NULL,detected_at=NOW(6),event_date=#{eventDate},reason=#{reason},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND active=0
UPDATE follow_up_reminder SET active=0,version=version+1 WHERE mentor_id=#{mentor} AND active=1 AND id NOT IN #{id}
mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_course c JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.id AND e.active=1 JOIN sys_user s ON s.id=e.student_id AND s.role_id=10 AND s.status='0' WHERE e.student_id=r.student_id AND c.mentor_id=#{mentor} AND c.deleted=0 AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND (r.course_id IS NULL OR r.course_id=c.id))
r.*,u.nick_name AS student_name,u.user_name AS username,c.title AS course_title
mapper.select: SELECT FROM follow_up_reminder r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=r.student_id LEFT JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=r.course_id WHERE r.mentor_id=#{mentor} AND AND r.active=1 AND r.reviewed=0AND r.active=1 AND r.reviewed=1AND r.active=0 AND r.student_id=#{studentId} ORDER BY r.detected_at DESC,r.id DESC
